name: Nantuko
description: A sapient race of mostly benevolent man-sized insects who respect nature and protected the Krosan Forest; Kamigawan nantuko are affiliated with the Order of Jukai.

timeline.summary: Krosa is all but destroyed, leaving the fate of the Krosan Nantuko unknown.
timeline.quote: The current fate of the Krosan Nantuko is unknown, as Krosa has been all but destroyed after the machinations of Karona , the Mirari , and the time rifts.
